brief: Explicit user reference: creatures like #11 in attached 4x4 collage. Eight short-microfiber cushion creatures plus matching larger portraits and UI preview.
cataloguePrompt:
Generate EIGHT NEW ORIGINAL CREATURE AVATAR VARIANTS inspired specifically by character NUMBER 11 in the supplied user reference image.
PRIMARY INPUT: a 4x4 numbered character collage. Use ONLY NUMBER 11 — THIRD ROW, THIRD COLUMN: the cream/white soft rounded-square upholstered cushion creature with two black vertical oval eyes, short little arms, short stubby feet and one hand waving. This is the EXACT construction/style the user selected. IGNORE all other numbered characters, particularly the graphite rock #04, furry bear #10, glass cube #07 and purple cyclops #12.
The owner wants variants of THIS soft cushion creature, not Roki and not unrelated monsters. Preserve one compact integrated body/head, gently rounded square/cushion form, two clean black oval eyes directly on the fabric, tiny arms at the sides and small soft feet. No separate face panel, black visor, helmets, glowing eyes, rock facets, sneakers, clothing, hats, animal ears, antennae, fur tufts, wings, tails, props, mouth/teeth or extra eyes.
MATERIAL: beautifully rendered SHORT MICROFIBER / fine soft felt upholstery with barely visible weave and very subtle stitched construction. Touchably soft but crisp silhouette, not long furry/plush hair and not shiny plastic, gelatin or glass. High-end character design that fits a pearl-white fluid productivity UI. Friendly calm expressions, subtle differences in eye spacing and posture. Eyes remain bold enough to read at small avatar size.
OUTPUT: one LANDSCAPE 3:2 white character catalogue, 4 columns x 2 rows. Exactly eight evenly spaced full-body creatures, each paired with a matching HEAD/UPPER-BODY PORTRAIT inside a small neutral glass UI tile. The portrait excludes feet and most arms, keeping the creature's distinctive top/body silhouette and black eyes, filling about 88% of the tile. Each cell has the exact two-digit number and short name below; no long descriptions. Full bodies about 200px tall, portraits about 60px as an illustration of small UI scale. Small header "Cushion creatures / Avatar studies". Pure WHITE background #FFFFFF, gentle cool neutral contact shadows, no beige scene, no colored environment or pedestal. Do not reproduce the whole 16-character input grid.
THE EIGHT VARIANTS:
01 CLOUD — closest to original #11: warm-neutral white rounded square cushion, short tiny arms, one gently raised hand, stubby feet, upright friendly black oval eyes. No body recoloring into beige/tan.
02 BLUE — saturated cobalt/azure short microfiber, BROAD LOW rounded-cube body with substantial little feet and relaxed side arms, eyes slightly widely spaced. Stable grounded personality.
03 CORAL — vivid coral-red fabric, TALLER NARROW cushion block, softly pinched upper corners, one short arm lightly raised, upright close-set oval eyes. Do not add ears.
04 JADE — vivid emerald-green microfiber, COMPACT ASYMMETRICAL block with one soft sloping shoulder and slightly forward-curious stance, two calm oval eyes, tiny feet.
05 HONEY — clear golden-yellow fabric, WIDE LOW cushion with two very softly doubled upper curves and a shallow center notch, friendly wider-spaced black eyes, one small waving arm. The curves belong to the cushion body, not animal ears.
06 SKY — saturated cyan-blue fabric, gently ROUNDED DOMED RECTANGLE body with a flat soft base, one subtly folded upper corner and short outstretched arms; two clear oval eyes. No transparent droplet or glass.
07 TANGERINE — vivid tangerine-orange microfiber, SOFTLY TAPERED pillow body slightly wider at the bottom, short low arms, small paired feet and calm black eyes. More rounded cheeks but still a cushion construction, not a fruit or flame.
08 LIME — bright lime/yellow-green felt, SQUARED ROUND-RECTANGLE body with a small offset soft shoulder step on one side, compact upright posture, tiny hands/feet and curious slightly unequal eye spacing. No leaves or plants.
FAMILY CONSISTENCY: same lighting, material scale, simplified face language and tiny limb construction across all eight. Each differs in silhouette/proportions AND color, not just paint on the same mesh. No glossy robot bodies. No eyes or limbs like another numbered reference. Make these look like genuine siblings of option 11, useful as clear larger bot avatars at roughly 52–56px. Preserve the calm, friendly simplicity that makes #11 appealing.
uiPreviewPrompt:
Edit Input 1, the approved pearl/fluid Hermes Studio desktop+phone UI with a bottom avatar strip. Input 2 is the newly generated CUSHION CREATURE catalogue based on the user's selected reference character #11.
Preserve the entire interface, its desktop/phone arrangement, white-glass panels, pearl-blue/amber background, typography, text, files/memory widgets, point-cloud activity, pill composer and current generous avatar sizes. Change ONLY the avatar art everywhere and the corresponding bottom identity strip. No interface redesign or extra panels.
REPLACE THE AVATARS WITH THESE EXACT CREATURES FROM INPUT 2:
Atlas / Chief of staff = 02 BLUE, broad low cobalt-blue microfiber cushion creature.
Nova / Creative partner = 03 CORAL, taller narrow coral-red cushion creature.
Scout / Research analyst = 04 JADE, green asymmetric cushion creature with one soft sloping shoulder.
Echo / Writing partner = 05 HONEY, golden-yellow wide cushion creature with gently doubled upper curves.
Maintain the different body silhouettes and short soft fabric material, with two crisp BLACK upright oval eyes directly on the fabric. No Roki, rock, visor, robot panel, hard plastic, letters or emblems.
IMPORTANT UI CROPPING: in all sidebar and message/phone avatar tiles use matching FACE + UPPER-BODY PORTRAITS, excluding feet and most limbs, so the eye pair and distinctive top/body silhouette fill 85-90% of the existing frame. Keep the enlarged size from Input 1 and do not shrink a full-body toy into a tiny circle. Every occurrence of each named bot matches exactly. Echo's message avatars are the golden Honey creature, not the previous double-lobed geometric head. Preserve enough silhouette that Atlas is broad, Nova tall, Scout sloped and Echo low/wide.
BOTTOM STRIP: show the four matching FULL-BODY cushion creatures with tiny short arms and stubby feet, labelled Atlas, Nova, Scout, Echo, each beside its compact portrait sample. Their limbs are soft fabric, no shoes, clothing, hats, props or animal ears. This is the only place full bodies should be used.
Lighting and finish should feel calm and touchable beside the pearl-white glass. Keep saturated body colors readable without loud colored UI backgrounds. Small concept caption "Cushion companions / Design preview". Keep all UI labels and conversations untouched. Landscape 3:2 aspect ratio.
